The '''TreeFelling vibrosaw''' also known as the '''Tree Felling Vibro-Saw''' and the '''GLC 075 Vibro-Saw''' was a [[vibrosaw]] manufactured by the [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]]. It was primarily designed for use by [[logger]]s working on the [[greel tree]]s in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]]. It required two [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] to operate. It was designed for clearing large vegetation, but it was sometimes used to saw through bulkheads during boarding actions. It could also be used as a weapon if needed.
